Ravi Gupta: Quick Q  I'm switching to a phased return (70%) mid-June. Do we get pro-rated parental leave top-up and childcare subsidy?

Maya (People Ops): Hi Ravi  parental top-up is based on actual leave days, and any ongoing subsidy is prorated by FTE during phased returns. For example, a 70% FTE gets 70% of the subsidy cap.

Ravi Gupta: Sounds good. How do I set the top-up to hit the exact pay periods covering my partial weeks?

Ivy (Benefits): You'll want to submit the leave end/start dates in the HR portal and select "phased return" and your planned weekly schedule (e.g., Mon-Wed onsite, Thu remote) so payroll can align top-up payments. Also upload manager confirmation.

Ravi Gupta: If I request an advance for childcare costs before the phased return starts, is that allowed?

Maya (People Ops): We can do a conditional advance in exceptional cases. Submit a ticket explaining why, include receipts/estimates, and tag for Finance approval. Advances will be recovered from future reimbursements if not used for eligible expenses.

Ravi Gupta: Uploaded estimate and manager note. Case #PR-3300.

Payroll Bot: Case PR-3300 registered. If advance approved, funds will be issued via payroll code ADVCHR on next off-cycle.

Ivy (Benefits): We'll review and confirm within 3 business days. Make sure to include whether you're US-based for tax handling.

Ravi Gupta: US-based. Thanks folks.
